newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c. bank to launch new stabilisation steps.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c. bank to launch new stabilisation steps.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Friday it will announce new, stricter financial stabilisation measures next week after its board decides on the specific steps it wants to include.

"The new package of stabilisation measures will involve more instruments from BNB's arsenal, which so far have not been used," BNB board member Zdarvko Balyosov told reporters after the board meeting. He declined to elaborate.
The BNB board meeting began on Thursday and will continue on Monday.
"The board will meet every day until it comes to a decision (on the detasils)," said Balyosov.
The International Monetary Fund (IMF) postponed a second tranche of its funding programme for Bulgaria until the government closed loss-making state enterprises.
The IMF urged Bulgaria to restore public confidence in local troubled banks by stabilising its financial system.

An IMF technical team led by Division Chief in the Monetary and Exchange Affairs department Charles Enoch is currently in Sofia. The mission, which visits Bulgaria regularly, is reviewing all areas of money policy and accounting standards.
